$meta.name: SYCONIA Design Tokens — production foundation
rules: Single source for M1-T003 /app/styles/tokens.css generation; values here mirror the specs verbatim — do not fork.
Raw hex is permitted ONLY in this file and its CSS descendant (CI-CD G-8).
Entries marked "_decision" fix values the specification leaves open; each cites its rationale and is registered in .ai/DECISIONS.md. They are documented decisions, not invented requirements.
Contrast ratios computed per WCAG relative-luminance formula vs Obsidian #09090B; computed math governs conformance (brand-guidelines PDF figures do not compute — discrepancy B-1, DESIGN-SYSTEM §4).

emerald.role: primary backdrop band, hero washes, emerald surfaces

obsidian.role: app background (dark theme is the only theme)

gold.role: Ostiole Gold — accents, active states, emblem line

champagne.role: Champagne Gold — wordmark accents, secondary accents, focus ring

alabaster.role: primary text on dark, editorial highlights

color.status_color_rules: functional-only; desaturated toward palette; no new hues; gold-as-text law per DESIGN-SYSTEM §4 (both golds pass AA normal text on dark; body copy stays Alabaster as editorial hierarchy; large-only restriction applies to light surfaces only).

serif.use: hero headlines, section titles, editorial/legal titles, major numbers, empty-state serif lines

sans.use: everything else (nav, buttons, forms, tables, metadata, admin)

typography.wordmark: official asset only (branding/syconia-primary-logo.png or transparent variant) — never typeset
typography.variable_fonts: single variable TTF per family (Fraunces: SOFT/WONK/opsz/wght; Inter: opsz/wght); weights <400 forbidden for text
typography.italics: _decision D-008: no italic style in v1 — no specification requires italics; italic instances are therefore not bundled
typography.rules: min body 16px; measure 70–80ch; text-wrap: balance on headings; subsets+preload+font-display swap per PERFORMANCE §2 (wired in M1-T004)

scale._note: spec fixes only --space-1:4px … --space-8:64px on an 8px base (DESIGN-SYSTEM §6); intermediate steps interpolated on that base — decision D-006

space.logo_clear: --space-logo-clear = 4× ostiole-dot diameter (DESIGN-SYSTEM §3); applied as padding around all logo placements

border.gold_hairline: reserved: active nav rail + focus ring ONLY

elevation.rules: shadows only; no glows, no colored shadows

interaction_states.hover_underline: gold underline grow 120ms on overlay buttons (GESTURES §4)
interaction_states.state_values: _decision D-006b: per-component state values (hover surfaces, pressed scale, disabled opacity) are fixed in each primitive's Storybook spec at M1-T008…T010 against these tokens; disabled text = --color-text-tertiary (5.6:1, >=14px). No ad-hoc values.

responsive_invariants: no horizontal overflow at 320px; wordmark→symbol <480px; media 16:9; motion transform/opacity only

container._decision: D-006 — spec fixes only S-07 watch max-w 1280; the ladder below extends that documented value consistently
container.hero_band: full-bleed emerald bands; inner content respects content_max_w

z_index._decision: D-006 — ladder derived from spec'd component layering (SCREENS S-00 drawer/scrim, ERROR-STATES toasts, GESTURES §5 shortcuts overlay, full-screen failure ladder)
z_index.dev_only: no z-index value outside this ladder (G-8 lint extension at M1-T002 may enforce)

transitions.ostiole_loader: dot scale 1→1.12 + opacity pulse 1.2s alternating (brand loading signal)

motion.laws: transform/opacity only; no infinite animations besides loader (pauses off-screen); will-change transient
motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → durations 0, opacity-only <=100ms, no shimmer/pulse loops, loader = static emblem

imagery.content_thumbnails: source-provided media via image proxy — never authored (DESIGN-SYSTEM §11)
imagery.category_hero: deterministic token-palette gradient meshes, generated locally at runtime — no static files, no external art
